_about: Numbers for the count placeholders in parts/*.html. An entry is a plain value or { value, source, pending }; groups nest and are addressed with dots. Keys that start with an underscore are ignored by the build. Every figure names its source: a file and what was counted, or the command that produced it. A figure that is not measured yet is marked pending, and the strict build refuses a page that uses one. The file is edited by hand: recount a figure when its source changes and rewrite its source line with the new date. Sources are repository paths. Short forms: notes = docs/mvp-2026-11; brief = MVP-PROMPT.md at the repository root.
